Minimum Education

Enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate degree program at an accredited university and returning to continue studies after the internship.

Minimum Experience

0

Summary

The Federal Reserve Board (Board) provides students opportunities for career success. The Board’s Internship program is designed to provide valuable work experience for undergraduate and graduate students considering careers including, but not limited to, economics, finance and accounting, information systems, and data analysis. The Board believes that by combining academic endeavors with project-related work experience, qualified and capable college students can gain the practical knowledge need in a competitive global job market. Internships are paid positions with salaries commensurate with credit hours; internships may be in-person, remote or hybrid, depending on the needs of the team. Employment in the Board’s internship program is granted to U.S. citizens. Applicants must be currently enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate degree program at an accredited university and returning to continue studies after the internship. Interns receive a syllabus or research project plan outlining their projects and goals for the internship. Interns are assigned a supervisor or mentor to guide them through their internship, and regular check-in meetings with their manager to manage performance expectations and assist with learning goals. Interns have access to a wide range of training programs and events for professional development purposes.

About the Role


The Business Operations team within Facility Services drives operational excellence in facility management for the Federal Reserve Board of Governors. By improving workflows, supporting strategic planning, and maintaining essential documentation, Business Operations helps the organization operate effectively and remain compliant with policies and best practices.


As a Business Operations Intern, you will provide administrative and analytical support to the Facility Services team and gain hands-on experience with the business processes that support day-to-day operations. You will have the opportunity to assist in the planning, development, and implementation of programs and projects while working closely with both the construction and operations sections of Facility Services. This role offers valuable exposure to business operations in a federal environment and the chance to strengthen professional skills in organization, collaboration, and problem-solving.


Skills/Experience

  • Research and Business analysis
  • Good organization, communications and research skills
  • Familiarity with MS Office Suite, SharePoint and Adobe CS
  • Proven ability to manage and coordinate administrative functions
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Proficient in using a variety of business and industry-specific applications
  • Excellent written and verbal communications skills
  • Dedicated to delivering exceptional customer service
  • Detailed-oriented with strong editing/ Proofreading

 


Notes:

  • U.S. Citizenship is required.
  • Applicants must be current students, graduating from their program August 2027 or later. Proof of enrollment will be required.
  • This position requires an onsite presence at our offices in Washington, D.C.
